primary_sources.title: GitHub Docs - Monitoring and troubleshooting self-hosted runners
relevant_rules: Runner status Idle means connected and ready; Active means executing; Offline means not connected, which can result from host offline, runner app not running, or inability to communicate with GitHub.
Linux runner service state can be diagnosed through the runner .service file/systemctl and journalctl.
Runner application logs are under _diag and begin Runner_; per-job logs begin Worker_.

primary_sources.title: GitHub Docs - Configuring the self-hosted runner application as a service
relevant_rules: On Linux/systemd, svc.sh is the supported service management surface after registration.
sudo ./svc.sh status checks service state; sudo ./svc.sh start starts a stopped service.

minimal_discriminator_order: On the actual registered runner host, locate the actions.runner service without changing registration: inspect the runner .service file if present, otherwise systemctl --type=service and filter actions.runner.
Check service state with the existing runner installation's sudo ./svc.sh status or systemctl status for the discovered service.
If stopped/failed, inspect recent journalctl for the exact actions.runner service and the newest _diag/Runner_*.log before mutation.

If service is healthy but GitHub still assigns zero jobs, inspect Runner_ logs for session/auth/network/registration/access failures; distinguish transport failure from repository/runner-group eligibility failure.

Only after the root class is observed, perform the smallest repair: start/restart service for service failure; repair network for connectivity failure; repair registration/access only when evidence identifies that class.

Do not print, persist, or commit runner registration tokens/PATs/secrets. If an authenticated config connectivity check is needed, consume credentials from an already-authorized secret surface without echoing them.
After repair, do not create another ASR workflow. Observe existing run 33292903286 acquire a runner and persist its terminal clay-direct-dev receipt.

minimum: existing run 33292903286 transitions out of queued because an eligible runner accepts it
not_granted: Qwen3-ASR quality PASS before model load/inference receipt
